verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a draft-vs-published model within a single flow, plus approval-gated publishing in Sensitive projects. That is an adjacent publishing control, not source-control integration or dev-to-production environment promotion. Nothing documents Git sync, flow export or import for versioning, or multi-environment promotion.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version workflows through source control or environments and promote changes from dev to production

citations.quote: The changes you make won't work right away to avoid disrupting the flow that's already published. To enable your changes, simply click on the publish button once you're done with your changes.
In projects marked as **Sensitive**, publishing requires review from a user with the `PUBLISH_SENSITIVE_FLOW_ACCESS` permission.
